author: (Gmelin, 1791)
evidence: GBIF: 2 survey records (Punta Cahuita 8 m, off Manzanillo 6 m, 1998)

about.en: The shiny auger is a slender, spiral snail of clean sand. It lies buried and moves at night to hunt worms. It was recorded in sand beside reef at Punta Cahuita and off Manzanillo in 1998 at 6 to 8 m. It is not eaten.
about.es: El caracol aguja brillante es un caracol espiral y delgado de arena limpia. Pasa enterrado y se mueve de noche a cazar gusanos. Se registró en arena junto al arrecife en Punta Cahuita y frente a Manzanillo en 1998, a 6 y 8 m. No se come.

idTips.en: A slender, polished shell with 12 or more whorls, usually pale with dark spots or a brown band. The aperture is small and oval.
idTips.es: Concha delgada y pulida de 12 o más vueltas, por lo general pálida con manchas o una banda café. La abertura es pequeña y ovalada.

diet.en: Marine worms (polychaetes) that it paralyses with venom; the exact prey here was not found.
diet.es: Gusanos marinos (poliquetos) que paraliza con veneno; no se encontró la presa exacta aquí.

predators.en: Crabs, rays, and fish that feed on sand.
predators.es: Cangrejos, rayas y peces que se alimentan en la arena.

behaviour.en: Buried in clean sand with only the tip showing, it moves out at dusk and at night to hunt. Augers are harmless to people.
behaviour.es: Enterrado en arena limpia con solo la punta visible, sale al atardecer y de noche a cazar. Los caracoles aguja no son peligrosos para las personas.

where.en: Clean sand beside reef at Punta Cahuita and off Manzanillo, 6 to 8 m.
where.es: Arena limpia junto al arrecife en Punta Cahuita y frente a Manzanillo, a 6 a 8 m.

edibleNote.en: Not eaten: a slender shell with almost no meat.
edibleNote.es: No se come: concha delgada con casi nada de carne.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Survey records at Punta Cahuita and off Manzanillo, 1998.

marks.en: Slender polished shell with twelve or more whorls, pale with dark spots or a brown band.
marks.es: Concha esbelta y pulida con doce o más vueltas, pálida con manchas oscuras o una banda café.
